title: I have made a website that hosts everyone's AI games completely free - no catch, and full credit to all developers with links to their socials/other games. Even offer GitHub hosting - at ViberCove.com
author: W3103_
selftext:
\*deleted old post\*   
  
Currently hosting over 200 of the best vibecoded and ai games around (and a few stinkers of my own) - have a play and send me your good games and tools at [vibercove.com](http://vibercove.com)



Even if it's on GitHub I can host it directly on the site. All games link direct to your website/socials so you get the traffic as well as people playing the game you made



No commercial services or anything being offered, just trying to get the spotlight on more devs. Free site, not even hosting ads, I can't stress enough I literally have nothing to gain here I just want one centralized place we can all play our games!

thanks guys 

joe @ viber cove  -  mods pls let this stay up i beg you

  
(changed the name after feedback, annoyingly my gf said the whole time slopville was a bad name, but i wont tell her she was right lol)

replies.author: EnumeratedArray
replies.body:
That's a pretty big risk you're taking if you want this to be even slightly successful. Certain countries like the UK require NSFW games to be gated behind verified ID checks and they will fine you for being in breach of that. The services you'd have use for such aren't cheap. Your verification process would have to be quite solid to make sure nothing slips through should you ban NSFW games too.

If the verification process is just you playing the game, that doesn't sound too scalable either. If it ended up popular like Itch with several hundred submissions per day, you'd struggle to play them all even working full time.

Personally I wouldn't want to risk my ability to work and travel around the world so some stranger can host their NSFW vibe coded game at my expense.
